data.body: Fixed by Gerrit change 3136 (merged; LLM-Review+1, Verified+1): fsck now reports the related and unrelated DIVERGED cases separately, counts local-only and remote-only commits, warns against re-cloning in the related case, and names the real command, rebar store fsck-recover. Tests check both messages and that every named command parses. make verify: 19825 passed, 0 failed.
